headline: Claude Mythos cuts GPU onboarding from months to days, disrupting vendor lock-in
body: Anthropic's Claude Mythos model has reduced the time to integrate AMD GPUs into software systems from up to 12 months to approximately three days by autonomously writing nearly 100 percent of GPU kernels. This capability undermines Nvidia's historical CUDA dominance and signals a meaningful shift in hardware flexibility for AI infrastructure. For healthcare organizations building or evaluating AI systems, reduced vendor lock-in translates directly to negotiating leverage, lower infrastructure switching costs, and protection against single-vendor pricing escalation. Consulting firms advising health systems on AI infrastructure should factor this development into multi-year IT roadmaps and RFP strategies. The expanded hardware optionality also creates runway for cost optimization in value-based care applications where compute efficiency directly impacts margin.
